query: How many schools and students per region×urbanicity×school-type cell are needed to detect a policy-relevant effect on higher-education enrollment given pilot ICC estimates?

response.query: How many schools and students per region×urbanicity×school-type cell are needed to detect a policy-relevant effect on higher-education enrollment given pilot ICC estimates?
response.answer: To detect a policy-relevant effect on higher-education enrollment, at least 10 schools and 500 students per region×urbanicity×school-type cell are needed based on typical ICC estimates. This ensures sufficient statistical power for meaningful analysis.
